senses.gloss: (b. h.; denom. of כֶּרַע)to bow, bend the knee.
units: Ber. 12ᵃ כשהוא כוֹרֵעַ וכ׳ when bowing in prayer, one must bow at the word barukh, opp. זָקַף.
<cite ref="Berakhot 34b:7">Ib. 34ᵇ</cite>; Y. ib. I, 3ᶜ bot. (interch. with <he>שחה</he>); a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: to cause to kneel; to subdue; to humiliate, sadden.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65">Gen. R. s. 65</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 114:3">Yalk. Gen. 114</cite> <he>אני מַכְרִיעַ את אוהבי</he> I shall sadden my friend.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 75">Gen. R. s. 75</cite>, beg., v. <cite ref="K01145"><he>כָּרַח</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 67:8">Gen. R. s. 67</cite> <he>מה אני מכריע וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 116">Yalk. ib. 116</cite> <he>מַעֲכִיר</he>) why shall I sadden my father?

senses.gloss: to put the knee of the balance down; to overbalance; to outweigh. Y. Peah I, 16ᵇ bot. הזכיות מַכְרִיעוֹת the good deeds overbalance (the sins).
units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:8">Ab. II, 8</cite> <he>מַכְרִיעַ את כלם</he> outweighs them all.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 5:11">B. Bath. V, 11</cite> <he>חייב להַכְרִיעַ לו טפח</he> (weighing a litra of meat or more) he must allow the scale (which contains the meat) to sink one handbreadth lower than the scale of weights, i.e. he must give overweight, opp. <he>עיין</he> to weigh exactly.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 89a:12-13">Ib. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>שקול לי … והַכְרִיעָהּ</he> weigh for me each litra for itself and give me the legal overweight on it; a. fr.—Y. Sabb. I, 3ᶜ bot. <he>הַכְרַע עליו כסף</he> put money to it in the balance (bribe him).
Gen. R. s. 80 כמה ממון ה׳ how much money he put in the balance (paid for it).—Trnsf. to cast the deciding vote, to decide.

<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 7:1">Tosef. Ḥull. VII, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 90b">Ḥull. 90ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 83b:6">Pes. 83ᵇ</cite> <he>הדעת מַכְרַעַת</he> reason decides, v. <cite ref="D00950"><he>דַּעַת</he></cite>. Y. Keth. II, 26ᵇ; Y. Yeb. X, 10ᵈ bot. <he>הדעת מכרעת בעידי מיתה</he> (not <he>לידי</he>) reason decides in favor of trusting the witnesses testifying to the death of a person.

senses.gloss: to keep the balance; trnsf. to harmonize two contrary opinions, to compromise. Sifra introd. שני כתובים המכחישים … ויַכְרִיעַ ביניהם when two Biblical verses contradict each other, you must not draw any conclusions until a third verse is found which harmonizes them. Ib. end (ref. to Ex. XIX, 20 a.
units: <cite ref="Deuteronomy 4:36">Deut. IV, 36</cite>) <he>הכ׳ השלישי</he> a third passage (<cite ref="Exodus 20:22">Ex. XX, 22</cite>) harmonizes (that the Lord lowered the heavens so as to make them rest on Mount Sinai); Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod. s. 9.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 24b:7">Kidd. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>המַכְרִיעִים לפני חכמים</he> the harmonizers arguing before the scholars.

<cite ref="Shabbat 39b:6">Sabb. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>כל מקום … ואחד מכריע הלכה כדברי המכ׳</he> whenever you find two scholars differing and one compromising, the practice follows the opinion of the compromiser; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="E00524"><he>הֶכְרַע</he></cite>, <cite ref="E00525"><he>הַכְרָעָה</he></cite>.
